briefdescription.para: Compute population variance as 64-bit integer and Q0.32 fractional parts without overflow.

detaileddescription.para: Uses sum = q_m * N + r_m (|r_m| < N) and the identity E[(X - mu)^2] = E[(X - q_m)^2] - (r_m / N)^2 so fractional means are exact.

parameterdescription.para: Output Q0.32 fractional part of variance in [0, 2^32 - 1].

detaileddescription.para: Population variance: Σ(x - mean)² / N, returned as Q16.16. Returns 0 if fewer than 2 samples.
